character_reference_strategy.notes: The artist wanted templates plus reference-sheet prompts for recurring implied character consistency.

visual_reference_sheet_strategy.notes: Reference-sheet prompts are drafted; generated sheets still require Generation Approval.

page_or_panel_plan.visual_role: Cover image that makes the warm threshold inviting and uncertain.
page_or_panel_plan.prompt_brief: A quiet hallway cover image with the warm doorway as the main symbolic pull.
page_or_panel_plan.style_continuity_notes: Keep the unseen host implied through light rather than showing a figure.

page_or_panel_plan.visual_role: Interior spread that turns approach into choice.
page_or_panel_plan.prompt_brief: A child-readable but emotionally tense spread of the half-open door and warm light.
page_or_panel_plan.style_continuity_notes: Use the same warm practical light and restrained realism from the cover.

visual_continuity_rules: Warm practical light is the repeated visual signature.
Do not show the Door Keeper unless the artist approves changing the absence rule.

text_image_relationships.relationship: The cover promises the emotional situation without resolving it.
The spread gives the reader visual pressure while the text stays sparse.

generation_policy.notes: No page or spread image prompts should expand in bulk before Illustration Plan Approval.

traceability_summary.note: The Illustration Plan waits for text structure before mapping spreads.
The cover and spread map to the invitation and threshold beats.
